### Evidence quotations used

#### Enterprise Connectivity: assisted monthly invoice procedure
## Situation
Enterprise Connectivity: An on-demand, non-negotiated monthly internet transfer bundle has completed provider exports and awaits customer-authorized assisted invoicing. Completion yields the accepted source net invoice and its separately identifiable statutory tax debit.

## Step 1
The customer themselves performs authorize_network_11d4a76e to sign and file the prepared invoice-ceiling acceptance. The form already has an identifiable reference, but identity availability does not establish completed customer acceptance. Filing retains that reference and returns the actual filing receipt.

## Step 2
The agent performs price_network_84b98f50 to determine the accepted source net amount. The actual customer filing receipt supplies the acceptance identity; the accepted monetary input exists only after the customer action.

## Step 3
The agent performs invoice_network_9ee25cfe to issue the net invoice component. The approved assessment supplies the exact review identity and assessed amount; the invoice receipt identifies the newly issued net receivable.

## Step 4
The agent performs tax_network_645ca35d to complete the statutory tax component against that exact net invoice. The preceding invoice receipt supplies the source identity, and tax uses the actually issued rounded net amount.

## Ordering reason
Customer acceptance must precede pricing because its net ceiling bounds the assessed amount. Assessment must precede net issuance because only an approved assessment contributes assessed net. Net issuance must precede tax because tax is computed on that actually issued amount and attaches to its identifier. All four effects are immediate desk or customer account actions over preexisting exports; none waits for outside work.

## Immediate execution
Provider exports and signoff are already complete. Customer filing, accountant assessment, net issuance and statutory tax posting occur synchronously at the same fixed handling time. No outside processing, clearing, publication, later approval or elapsed time is required.

## Ordering Q&A
Swapping customer filing and assessment would leave no completed customer acceptance supplying the net ceiling. Swapping assessment and net issuance would leave no approved assessed net. Swapping net issuance and tax would leave no actually issued amount and invoice identity to support the tax attachment.

#### Enterprise Connectivity: connectivity meter pricing
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs connectivity meter pricing for service charge, ancillary meter, nonfinancial service record.

## Policy clause 1
The selected contract provides committed line capacity line capacity; exceeding it requires a signed capacity amendment, while data transfer billing remains based on actual measured GB.

## Policy clause 2
Primary meter internet outbound transfer uses standard unit price after monthly included outbound transfer for the same holding and calendar month. provisioned port hours use port-hour price; cross-zone transfer, cross-region transfer, private interconnect outbound transfer and ingress use same-region cross-zone price, cross-region transfer price, private interconnect outbound price and inbound transfer price respectively.

## Policy clause 3
A transfer has exactly one destination class, so those destination rates never add together. NAT processed GB uses NAT processing price and NAT provisioned hours uses NAT provisioning price as distinct processing and provisioning components. allocated IPv4 address-hours uses allocated IPv4 address-hour price per allocated address-hour, including unused allocated addresses. new physical connection uses physical connection provisioning fee per completed new physical connection; a reprovisioned existing connection is not a new setup. loadbalancer uses load-balancer capacity-hour price per capacity-unit-hour.

## Policy clause 4
No Network transfer is invoiced if its export assigns billing ownership to another product; the assigned product exclusively invoices it.

## Policy clause 5
Free ingress stays visible in the meter history without a financial charge.

## Policy clause 6
For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal places and rounding convention and tax under tax treatment rules.

The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval beginning then source-event reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

## Policy clause 8
Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

## Policy clause 9
Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices.

## Policy clause 10
These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

## Policy clause 11
For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

## Policy clause 12
Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic generic monthly included volume where expressly named; they are not added twice.

## Policy clause 13
A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Points of judgement

#### Enterprise Connectivity: net invoice amount
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this net invoice amount rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: outcome
For net transfer invoice, take the smaller of the approved assessed net and the posting ceiling. Compare that unrounded smaller amount with the minimum invoice amount: below the minimum it is carried without posting; otherwise round it half-up only once to the source-tier monetary precision. Issue exactly one net-only charge for internet outbound transfer, classified as primary service with portfolio pricing and the source UTC month. The distinct statutory tax component is added only after this net charge exists.

## Basis Q&A
| Smaller reviewed amount and posting ceiling | Invoice decision |
| --- | --- |
| Net transfer invoice: Below the minimum before rounding | Carry without posting |
| At least the minimum before rounding | Round once, half-up, and issue the net-only primary internet outbound charge with portfolio pricing for the source UTC month |

## Hypothetical calculation
Assume a hypothetical reviewed net USD 80, posting ceiling USD 60, minimum invoice USD 2 and two-decimal precision. The invoice amount is USD 60. If their smaller amount were USD 1.999, it would carry without a posting; rounding that amount upward before testing the minimum would change the decision.
